_comment: Differences between tlx and TLC on TLC's own regression suite (scripts/tlcsuite.py), by case name
(the JUnit test class). `id` may be a glob, `result` restricts an entry to failures where tlx reported
that result kind, `flaky` entries may pass too (timeouts under load). Regenerate with

expected_failures.reason: documented difference docs/compat.md D-19 (\cdot follows the TLA+ definition)
tlx's interpreter needs ~40 s CPU (SYMMETRY: canonicalizing every state over 48 permutations dominates; TLC 18 s, tlx -compile 7 s): a timeout under load
RandomElement in the spec: counts depend on TLC's random seed (TLC itself varies between runs)
documented difference docs/compat.md D-21 (ToJsonObject of a sequence built by a function constructor: TLC answers by representation)
tlx did not finish in time (TLC: success)
a Java class next to the spec (UserModuleOverride.class) overrides Get: tlx cannot run Java code, so it evaluates the TLA+ definition
